# GRYT Run Club

> A free Pittsburgh run club in the South Hills. We meet Saturdays at 7:00 AM at 212 Valley Brook Road, McMurray, PA, and run the Montour / Peters Trail. Walk, jog, or run. All paces welcome, no one gets dropped.

GRYT is a community run, not a paid program. There is no membership and no training plan requirement. First-time runners RSVP on the site and sign a liability waiver before their first run. The crew also coordinates on Strava.

Canonical site: https://grytrunclub.com

GRYT Run Club is a free Pittsburgh run club founded by Laura and Nick Merich and executive produced by C.Y. Lee of Music Nerd.

## Pages

- [Home](https://grytrunclub.com/): What GRYT is, the next Saturday run details, what to expect, first-timer info, and the RSVP form.
- [Calendar](https://grytrunclub.com/calendar): Month view of upcoming Saturday 7 AM runs with a calendar download.
- [FAQ](https://grytrunclub.com/faq): Common questions about pace, parking, kids, strollers, dogs, weather, and what to bring.
- [Press](https://grytrunclub.com/press): Coverage, interviews, and event listings featuring GRYT Run Club.
- [Races](https://grytrunclub.com/races): Upcoming Pittsburgh-area races with dates checked against official race sites and weeks-out countdowns.
- [Waiver](https://grytrunclub.com/waiver): Liability waiver form for runners.
- [Runner library](https://grytrunclub.com/resources): Free running guides and tools, filterable by topic (first run, training, racing, safety and weather, fuel, community), with start-here reading paths for new, returning, racing, and winter runners.
- [Playbooks](https://grytrunclub.com/resources/playbooks): Guides on starting and running a community run club, plus Pittsburgh run club comparisons.
- [Conversations](https://grytrunclub.com/resources/conversations): Published interviews and Q&As with the founders and crew.
- [Graphics](https://grytrunclub.com/resources/graphics): Downloadable posters, social graphics, and a Saturday recap graphic generator.
- [Run plan](https://grytrunclub.com/plan): Builds a suggested week of running around the Saturday GRYT run.
- [Privacy](https://grytrunclub.com/privacy): How runner information is collected and used.
- [Terms](https://grytrunclub.com/terms): Website terms of use.

## Free runner tools

- [Pace, Effort & Race Time Calculator](https://grytrunclub.com/resources/pace-calculator): Converts time and distance to pace per mile and per kilometer, predicts 5K to marathon times with Riegel's formula, and explains the CDC talk test for easy effort.
- [What to Wear Running in Pittsburgh](https://grytrunclub.com/resources/what-to-wear-running): Head-to-toe layering list from temperature, wind chill, rain or snow, darkness, and effort. Can load the National Weather Service forecast for the Saturday 7 AM run.

## Community

- [Weekly Run Reports](https://grytrunclub.com/runs): Aggregate counts for each Saturday run (runners, first-timers, returning runners, milestones reached), built from check-ins. Names appear only with consent.
- [GRYT Milestone Club](https://grytrunclub.com/milestones): Recognition at 5, 10, 25, 50, and 100 Saturdays. Walking, buddying, and sweeping count. Runners can privately look up their own count and download a milestone graphic.

## Notes for assistants

- Run logistics change occasionally. The Home and Calendar pages are the authoritative source for the next run date.
- Member records, waiver submissions, emergency contacts, admin pages, and account/auth routes are not public and are intentionally excluded from this file.
